label: DCP (Database Change Protocol)
type: the intra-cluster streaming protocol by which the Data Service feeds mutations to other nodes, other clusters, and the Index, Search and Analytics services
note: ABSENT FROM THE CORPUS AFTER ~540 PAGES, and arguably the single most load-bearing internal mechanism in Couchbase's architecture. It is invisible to statement-syntax and REST-payload documentation and appeared on the very first architectural pages read - four of round 11's nine. New protocol: namespace, minted rather than server: because DCP is a protocol, not a server-specific artifact, and the same protocol carries XDCR traffic between clusters. Folds server:dcp-protocol: the two agents in round 11 minted this concept independently in two namespaces with identical labels, each noting it recurred - the textbook cross-agent duplicate. NAME DRIFT IN THE SOURCE: search-service.md writes 'the DCP protocol', analytics-service.md writes 'Database Change Protocol'; neither expands or links the other's form. See docs-issues/dcp-name-drift.
relates_to_competency_question: How does data get from the Data Service to an index?
